en_us.cannery.centrifuge.0: Gas centrifuges can be supplied with fluid using regular fluid ducts.
en_us.cannery.centrifuge.1: Most recipes require multiple centrifuges. The intermediate products cannot be transported via pipes.
en_us.cannery.centrifuge.2: This side acts as a connector which outputs the intermediate product into an adjacent centrifuge.
en_us.cannery.centrifuge.3: Uranium hexafluoride can be processed with just two centrifuges, this however will produce Uranium fuel and Uranium-238.
en_us.cannery.centrifuge.4: Fully processing it into Uranium-235 and Uranium-238 requires a total of four centrifuges.
en_us.cannery.centrifuge.5: Some recipes also require the centrifuge overclocking upgrade.
en_us.cannery.crucible.0: The crucible is used to smelt ores, ingots or other metallic items for alloying and to cast them into different shapes.
en_us.cannery.crucible.1: It requires an external heat source connected to the bottom, like a firebox.
en_us.cannery.crucible.2: Once heated up, the crucible can be used in two ways, with or without a recipe template.
en_us.cannery.crucible.3: The crucible has two storage buffers for material:
en_us.cannery.crucible.4: The buffer to the left is for §abyproducts§r, all material smelted without a recipe template will land here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.5: If a recipe is installed, materials that do not match the recipe will also be stored here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.6: Materials in this buffer will not react with each other, they can only be output from the green outlet for casting.
en_us.cannery.crucible.7: The buffer to the right is for §crecipes§r, if a recipe is installed and that particular material is relevant to that recipe, it will land here.
en_us.cannery.crucible.8: The materials will slowly combine into the output material which is automatically output from the red outlet.
en_us.cannery.crucible.9: Note that only this buffer handles recipes. If a template is installed retroactively, materials in the byproduct buffer will not combine, nor transfer to the recipe buffer.
en_us.cannery.crucible.10: The outlet will output material automatically, if the target is valid, for example a foundry channel or a mold.
en_us.cannery.crucible.11: As with all foundry blocks, a shovel can be used to remove all material from the crucible.
en_us.cannery.fensu.0: The FEnSU is capable of storing absurd amounts of energy, over 9EHE (that's a nine followed by 18 zeros).
en_us.cannery.fensu.1: There is only one energy connector which can be found on the bottom.
en_us.cannery.fensu.2: This is also the only place where the FEnSU can receive a redstone signal.
en_us.cannery.firebox.0: The firebox burns flammable items to generate heat.
en_us.cannery.firebox.1: It can burn any flammable item, although higher quality fuels such as coal, coke and solid fuel burn longer and hotter.
en_us.cannery.firebox.2: Heat is given off by the copper contact at the top of the firebox. Machines with an identical contact on the bottom can receive heat by being placed on top of the firebox.
en_us.cannery.firebox.3: If heat isn't being used up and the heat buffer becomes full, the firebox will shut off to prevent wasting of fuel.
en_us.cannery.firebox.4: One such machine is the stirling engine, which will turn heat directly into energy.
en_us.cannery.foundryChannel.0: Foundry channels are used to transport molten material from a crucible or storage tank into molds.
en_us.cannery.foundryChannel.1: Channels can receive material either by pouring from the top - via an outlet or directly from a crucible - or from the side from other channels.
en_us.cannery.foundryChannel.2: When transporting materials, channels will prioritize blocks like outlets and shallow molds.
en_us.cannery.foundryChannel.3: When it cannot supply an outlet or a mold, the material will then flow into a neighboring channel.
en_us.cannery.foundryChannel.4: Leftover material can be removed by using a shovel.
en_us.cannery.silex.0: The Free Electron Laser (FEL) uses energy and a laser crystal to create a powerful laser beam.
en_us.cannery.silex.1: Be careful, as the laser will burn/melt through weaker blocks...
en_us.cannery.silex.3: The FEL is used to power the Laser Isotope Separation Chamber (SILEX). The FEL and SILEX have to be at least two blocks apart.
en_us.cannery.silex.4: The laser has to enter through the glass openings of the SILEX. Aiming it wrong could destroy it.
en_us.cannery.silex.5: The openings on the sides can be used to connect fluid ducts to the SILEX.
en_us.cannery.silex.6: In addition to the two connectors on the sides, there is a third hidden connector at the bottom from which items can be extracted.
en_us.cannery.silex.7: Each recipe requires a specific laser type. Using a stronger type than required will process items faster.
en_us.cannery.silex.8: One FEL can supply up to 5 SILEX. Each SILEX has to be one block apart from one another.
en_us.cannery.stirling.0: The Stirling engine uses heat energy from external sources to create power.
en_us.cannery.stirling.1: It needs to be placed on top of a heat-producing machine, such as the firebox.
en_us.cannery.stirling.2: The amount of heat it can utilize however is limited, overspinning can lead to catastrophic malfunction.
en_us.cannery.stirling.3: The upgraded version can take significantly more heat without breaking.
en_us.cannery.willow.0: The mustard willow is a plant that allows cadmium metal to be harvested.
en_us.cannery.willow.1: Willows can be placed on dirt, grass or even dead/oily dirt, but they require water to grow.
en_us.cannery.willow.2: Willows can be fertilized with bone meal or industrial fertilizer. They do not need light to grow.
en_us.cannery.willow.3: After the second stage of growth, they will need an extra block of space above them to grow further.
en_us.cannery.willow.4: After the fourth stage of growth, they require dead or oily dirt below them.
en_us.cannery.willow.5: This can be done either by manually planting willows on dead/oily dirt, or by having a hydraulic fracking tower nearby which continuously contaminates the ground.
en_us.cannery.willow.6: After reaching the final stage, the willow will remove contamination from the ground, reverting the dead/oily dirt back into regular dirt.
en_us.cannery.willow.7: Now the willow's leaves can be harvested. Breaking the top block will drop a small willow plant, 3-6 leaves and keep the bottom part of the plant intact.
en_us.cannery.willow.8: Soon the plant will start growing again, yielding more leaves if the dirt is replaced with oily dirt. The leaves can be processed into cadmium powder using an ore acidizer.
en_us.cannery.willow.9: Harvesting willow leaves can be automated using the automatic buzzsaw, it will only break plants that are ready for harvest.
en_us.cannery.hadron.0: A Particle Accelerator consists of three main parts: A Core, an Analysis Chamber, and a set of Superconducting Coils
en_us.cannery.hadron.1: This is the Particle Accelerator Core Component, which fires particles at relativistic speeds down the coils towards the Analysis Chamber
en_us.cannery.hadron.3: And in circular accelerators, return to here
en_us.cannery.hadron.4: A coil segment is constructed by using 8 Dense Coils with nothing (or the core) in the middle
en_us.cannery.hadron.5: This coil segment must itself also be enclosed within Particle Accelerator Plating
en_us.cannery.hadron.6: To access the Core Component, you'll need to add one or more Access Terminals
en_us.cannery.hadron.7: The Core Component will also require power to operate, add a power plug on an edge
en_us.cannery.hadron.8: The Accelerator will require enough Power Plugs to supply at least 10KHE of electricity per unit of Coil Strength
en_us.cannery.hadron.9: Note that the coil segment that wraps around the Core Component is not factored into the Coil Strength calculation
en_us.cannery.hadron.10: Nor is this coil segment required for purely linear accelerators
en_us.cannery.hadron.11: For circular accelerators, you will need to add corners to change the direction of the particle
en_us.cannery.hadron.12: The outside corner coils can be omitted entirely
en_us.cannery.hadron.13: The final part of our Accelerator is the Analysis Chamber, which is a 3x3x3 empty chamber surrounded by Analysis Chamber blocks
en_us.cannery.hadron.14: Your completed Particle Accelerator should look something like this!
en_us.cannery.schottky.0: This is a Schottky Particle Diode. It can allow for more complex particle accelerator designs and save on electricity
en_us.cannery.schottky.1: By default it blocks all particles and must be configured with a Screwdriver
en_us.cannery.schottky.2: This face will now accept entering particles
en_us.cannery.schottky.3: And this face will eject particles that enter
en_us.cannery.schottky.4: The diode now has two exits, and will now behave in a quantum manner, creating virtual particles for each exit
en_us.cannery.schottky.5: Once all the virtual particles have reached an Analysis Chamber, the particle with the lowest momentum required for the current recipe is chosen
en_us.cannery.schottky.6: The chosen particle undergoes a wavefunction collapse and is made real, consuming only the power that the collapsing particle requires
en_us.cannery.schottky.7: If any virtual particles encounter any malformed segments, all virtual particles will be discarded and the erroring particle will be collapsed instead
en_us.cannery.schottky.8: Note that virtual particles will never use the same Diode exit twice. Infinite loops will fail, but re-entering a Diode is otherwise fine
en_us.cannery.schottky.9: Your Schottky Particle Diode should be properly enclosed, with free paths for each intersection exit

zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.0: 气体离心机可以使用通用流体管道传输流体。
zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.1: 大多数配方需要多台离心机。中间产品不能通过管道运输。
zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.2: 该侧用作将中间产品输出到相邻离心机的连接口。
zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.3: 六氟化铀只需两台离心机即可加工，但这将只产出铀燃料和铀-238。
zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.4: 将其完全加工成铀-235和铀-238总共需要四台离心机。
zh_cn.cannery.centrifuge.5: 一些配方还需要离心机超频升级。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.0: 坩埚用于熔炼矿石、铸锭或其他金属物品以进行合金化，并将其铸造成不同形状。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.1: 它需要一个外部热源连接到底部，例如燃烧室。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.2: 一旦加热，坩埚可以以两种方式运行，有或没有配方模板。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.3: 坩埚有两个材料储存缓冲区：
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.4: 左边的缓冲区用于缓存§a副产品§r，所有没有配方模板的熔炼材料都将缓存在这里。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.5: 如果有熔炼配方，与配方不匹配的材料也将存储在这里。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.6: 该缓冲区中的材料不会相互反应，只能从绿色出口输出用于铸造。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.7: 右侧的缓冲区用于放入§c配方§r，如果安装了一个配方，并且该特定材料与该配方相关，则它将储存在此处。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.8: 这些材料将慢慢结合成输出材料，从红色出口自动输出。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.9: 请注意，只有这个缓冲区处理配方。如果更换模板，副产品缓冲区中的材料不会结合，也不会转移到配方缓冲区。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.10: 如果目标有效，例如铸造通道或模具，出口将自动输出材料。
zh_cn.cannery.crucible.11: 与所有铸造块一样，可以使用铲子从坩埚中移除所有材料。
zh_cn.cannery.fensu.0: FEnSU能够存储超过9EHE（即9后18个零）的荒谬能量。
zh_cn.cannery.fensu.1: 只有在其底部有一个电线接口。
zh_cn.cannery.fensu.2: 这也是FEnSU唯一可以接收红石信号的地方。
zh_cn.cannery.firebox.0: 燃烧室通过燃烧可燃物品产生热量。
zh_cn.cannery.firebox.1: 它可以燃烧任何可燃物品，但更高质量的燃料如煤、焦炭和固体燃料燃烧时间更长，温度更高。
zh_cn.cannery.firebox.2: 燃烧室顶部的铜触点可以传导热量。底部具有相同触点的机器可以通过放置在燃烧室顶部来接收热量。
zh_cn.cannery.firebox.3: 如果热量没有用完，且热量缓冲器变满，燃烧室将暂停运行，以防止燃料浪费。
zh_cn.cannery.firebox.4: 一种这样的机器是斯特林发电机，它将热量直接转化为能量。
zh_cn.cannery.foundryChannel.0: 铸造通道用于将熔融材料从坩埚或储罐输送到模具中。
zh_cn.cannery.foundryChannel.1: 通道可以通过从顶部（通过出口或直接连接坩埚）或从其他通道的侧面倾倒来接收材料。
zh_cn.cannery.foundryChannel.2: 运输材料时，渠道将优先考虑出口和浅铸造池等方块。
zh_cn.cannery.foundryChannel.3: 当无法供应出口或模具时，材料将流入相邻通道。
zh_cn.cannery.foundryChannel.4: 剩余材料可以用铲子清除。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.0: 自由电子激光器（FEL）利用能量和激光晶体产生强大的激光束。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.1: 小心，因为激光会烧毁或熔化较脆弱的方块…
zh_cn.cannery.silex.3: FEL用于为激光同位素分离室（SILEX）提供能量。FEL和SILEX必须至少相隔两个方块。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.4: 激光必须通过SILEX的玻璃开口进入。在错误的方向上入射可能会摧毁它。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.5: 侧面的开口可以使流体管道连接至SILEX上。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.6: 除了侧面的两个连接口之外，底部还有第三个隐藏连接口，可以从中抽取产品。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.7: 每个配方都需要特定的激光类型。使用比所需类型更强的激光将更快地处理项目。
zh_cn.cannery.silex.8: 一台FEL最多可以为5台SILEX供能。每个SILEX之间必须间隔一个方块。
zh_cn.cannery.stirling.0: 斯特林发电机使用来自外部的热能来产生能量。
zh_cn.cannery.stirling.1: 它需要放置在发热机器的顶部，如燃烧室。
zh_cn.cannery.stirling.2: 然而，它可以利用的热量有限，过旋转可能导致灾难性故障。
zh_cn.cannery.stirling.3: 升级版可以在不损坏的情况下承受更多热量。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.0: 芥子柳是一种可以富集镉金属的植物。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.1: 芥子柳可以种植在泥土、草地上，甚至是泥渣或油泥上，但它们需要水才能生长。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.2: 芥子柳可以用骨粉或工业肥料催熟。它们不需要光就可以生长。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.3: 在第二阶段的生长之后，它们将需要在上方有至少一个方块的空间才能进一步生长。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.4: 在生长的第四阶段之后，它们需要下面有泥渣或油泥。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.5: 这可以通过在泥渣或油泥上手动种植芥子柳来实现，也可以通过在附近设置一个不断污染地面的水力压裂塔来实现。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.6: 到达最后阶段后，芥子柳将清除地面上的污染物，使泥渣或油泥恢复为正常的泥土。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.7: 现在芥子柳的叶子可以收割了。打破顶部的块状物会掉落一株3-6片叶子的小芥子柳，并保持植物底部的完整。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.8: 很快，这种植物就会重新开始生长，如果泥土被油泥取代，就会长出更多的叶子。叶子可以用酸化机加工成镉粉。
zh_cn.cannery.willow.9: 使用自动锯可以自动收割柳叶，它只会打碎准备收割的植物。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.0: 粒子加速器包含3个主要部分: 核心，粒子分析室以及一系列的超导线圈。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.1: 画面上的方块为粒子加速器核心组件，会以相对论的速度沿线圈向粒子分析室发射粒子。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.3: 在环形加速器中，会回到此面。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.4: 每个线圈区段由8个致密线圈构成，中间留空（或放置粒子加速器核心）。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.5: 线圈区段本身也必须被粒子加速器镀层包裹。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.6: 加速器中还需要添加一个或多个粒子加速器接入终端，以与核心组件交互。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.7: 核心组件也需要电力运行，因此需要在边缘添加电源接口。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.8: 粒子加速器需要足够的电源接口来供给至少10kHE每单位线圈强度的能量。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.9: 注意：环绕核心组件的线圈区段不参与线圈强度计算，
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.10: 而且完全的直线粒子加速器不需要此区段。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.11: 环形加速器中，需要如下的转角结构来改变粒子的方向：
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.12: 外侧转角的线圈可以被完全去除。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.13: 粒子加速器的最终部分是粒子分析室，这是一个由分析室方块包围的3x3x3空间。
zh_cn.cannery.hadron.14: 搭建完成的粒子加速器的外观应该类似下面这样：
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.0: 画面上的方块为肖基特二极管。此方块可用于更复杂的粒子加速器设计，也可用于节省电能。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.1: 默认状态下，二极管会阻挡所有粒子，需要使用螺丝刀进行配置。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.2: 此面会接受进入的粒子，
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.3: 而此面会将进入的粒子发射出去。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.4: 现在图中的二极管含有两个出口，会表现出“量子”行为：在每个出口创造一个“虚拟粒子”。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.5: 一旦所有的“虚拟粒子”都达到了分析室，粒子加速器就会选择动量需求最低的配方执行。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.6: 被选中的粒子会经历“波函数坍缩”，变成真实的粒子，并且加速器只会消耗“坍缩”的虚拟粒子需求的能量。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.7: 如果某一个虚拟粒子进入了结构不正确的区段，所有的虚拟粒子都会被销毁，而且坍缩的将是出错的粒子而非其他到达分析室的粒子。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.8: 注意：同一个虚拟粒子只会经过同一个二极管的同一出口一次。虚拟粒子不会进入死循环，但仍然可以进入另一个二极管。
zh_cn.cannery.schottky.9: 肖基特二极管周围应具有合适的结构，使得粒子在每个交叉点处都有路可走。
